steps.step: A swallowed creature takes 2d6 damage per round inside the sturgeon's belly until the fish is killed or the creature dies.
Each round, the swallowed creature must save versus Paralysis or be paralyzed.
If armed with a sharp weapon and not paralyzed, the swallowed creature may attack from inside with a -4 to the attack throw versus effective AC 2.
If the swallowed creature dies and remains in the belly for 6 turns, it is irrecoverably digested.

treasure_rules.rule: Any encounter with giant sturgeons may yield treasure, whether wandering or in lair.
If present, treasure is always found inside the creature's belly.
